launchOverview.preEpochMarketNote: No buy-in is charged yet, but it is already accruing. Every sale adds its acquisition fee to the reserve, so the buy-in owed the moment the Epoch ends rises with each one.
launchOverview.postEpochMarketNote: The reserve compounds. Each acquisition returns its own buy-in to the reserve, so the buy-in climbs with every sale. Redemption pays out over 5,555 while buy-in divides by 5,554, and both round toward the reserve — so the share held by everyone still holding only grows.

launchOverview.supplyDefinitionsNote: Public distributed supply subtracts unsold pool inventory from the 800M public allocation. Strict liquid float also excludes unreleased treasury vesting and Vault backing from total supply.
launchOverview.depthNote: Maximum input near each target impact, quoted through the canonical Uniswap market. The fixed 1.5% pool fee is excluded from price impact.
launchOverview.metricsUnavailable: Launch metrics are temporarily unavailable. Trading and Vault actions remain independently verifiable onchain.

landing.eyebrow: The anchor is fixed. The market is not.
landing.heroDescription: Every basket is a fixed bundle, always redeemable for exactly what is inside it. No manager, no rebalancing, no liquidations. Markets move around that anchor — Statics pays the people who hold it steady.
landing.heroVisual: Digital marble statue of Robin Hood
landing.heroAlt: A fragmented digital marble statue of Robin Hood wearing a feathered cap and goatee
landing.basketsTitle: Put your bags in a basket.

landing.ownPositionDescription: Baskets, loans, and dollar series live in one position you can hold, transfer, or sell as a single asset.
